newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Manager of Czech state bond issue sets min price.
newsitem.headline: Manager of Czech state bond issue sets min price.

text.p: OFT Brokers, manager of the Czech Finance Ministry's state bond auction, said on Friday that its 2.85 billion crown five-year state bond auction would have a minimum price of 101.23.
The auction will be held on Monday and the bonds, which were issued last August when only 1.9 billion crowns worth were actually sold, will bear a 10.95 percent fixed coupon.

In the last auction, bonds worth only about 300 million crowns were sold due to a mix-up that left bidders without key information on the issue's minimum price, leaving the 2.85 billion of the issue for Monday's auction.
OFT said the minimum amount sold would be five million crowns. Price will be the main factor in evaluating bids, followed by amount.
Auctions will continue every Monday until the whole amount is sold.
